title: Tenma Saki — In My Empty Room〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hi, Saki. What brings you here?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Today, I'm here to repay you for what you did!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Repay me?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! Remember how you made it possible for us to finish our song?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I really don't think it would've turned out so well if you hadn't done what you did, Ichi.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, I'm going to do everything I can today to return the favor...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Umm... I really appreciate it, but aren't you sort of blowing things out of proportion?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, I'm not! Please, Ichi, let me do this!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Alright, if you're willing to go that far, then please go right on ahead.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay! Thanks, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, what do you plan on doing exactly?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That's a surprise!
For now, let's go!
Cafe

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, here we are!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Wait, I know this cafe...
Everyone in class has been talking about how good their churros are.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, your class too? Everyone in my class has also been talking about how amazing they are!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They've been saying how you can top freshly fried churros with chocolate and custard cream and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. The menu even says, “Enjoy crispy churros with a variety of scrumptious sauces! We recommend our special churros!” These look really good...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know, right?! I'm paying today, so get whatever you like.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
What? No, I can't make you pay.
I mean, I've been wanting to come here for a little while.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, but...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Alright, how about you just buy me a drink...? This fruit juice looks pretty decadent compared to the others.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, I'll buy you a drink...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Anyway, let's go order.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa! I didn't realize how crispy freshly fried churros are!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, and it's so good...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Saki, be careful not to burn your tongue...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. Don't worry.
The sauce is doing a good job of cooling it down!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This chocolate sauce is amazing♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Here, Ichi, try a bite! Open wide!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: W-Wait, we're in public...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Then, at least try some of this chocolate sauce.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks.
In that case, you should try some of my caramel sauce...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hmm... I can't decide what to get next.
Oh, Ichi, check it out!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They've got sauces made from apples, blueberries and a mix of fruits. They all sound really good...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wanna order a few things off this part of the menu...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sure, but are you really still that hungry?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whew... I'm getting pretty full...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait a second.
I'm having all the fun here. We're here because I'm supposed to be repaying you for what you did...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I-Ichi, you gotta have some more!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Okay.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But you really don't have to wait on me hand and foot. I'd rather you just enjoyed yourself...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You looked so happy while eating those churros, Saki. That really put a smile on my face.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, I think you've already given me back plenty.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, to make you smile even more, I'm gonna keep enjoying these churros!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Ichi, you gotta try this mixed-fruits sauce! It's really good!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks for offering.
Then, if you don't mind...
